items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: He had the band at the old Abson house... And, uh, we had, uh, Bill Crego, a fellow by the name of Joe Lambious... And, uh, Red, Red Long, no, no, a fellow by the name of Joe Garrow

ctx.x: And who did Bill Crego play with?

He played with, with Naylor. Well, but here, he had the band, that's the, he, he's the first band I worked with in the quality. He had the band at the old Abson house. Uh, see, not, not where the bar is, of the old Abson, but in the, in the, in the back where Piron plays. I'm not, I mean where Pichon, where Fats plays. Well, that was the club, you see. And it was owned by two different people. The bar, well, that's the original bar across from the famous door. That's the bar that was at, at Arberville Street.…
Well, we might ask about drum solos and style of playing drums, the way it used to be and the way it is now. We only have another minute, unless you have something dictated. No, that's not.
